verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The live-turn architecture is fully covered end to end: web/mobile entry, input screening, profile/transcript/article context assembly, model generation, conditional credentialed actions, output screening, fallback replacement, and human escalation with its full transfer package.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: No stated requirement is absent, partial, or contradicted.
verdict.coverage_summary: All 34 atomic requirements are visibly represented and consistent across the PNG and canvas JSON. The board covers the complete live assistant path, durable-memory and retention semantics, versioned champion/challenger experimentation, human-controlled promotion and rejection, retained-champion rollback, and independent regression monitoring with immediate challenger removal.
